name: Ōsaki (Kagoshima, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ōsaki town emblem in white: a disc with a stylised bird in flight.
history: Municipal flag of Ōsaki, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in October 1968.

features.role: Ōsaki town emblem — a disc with a stylised bird in flight
